fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $67,000 for a territory of approximately 40,000–60,000 qualifying households. An additional $0.70 per target household applies above 60,000. In the year ended December 31, 2025, the average fee paid was approximately $62,355 and the actual range paid was $28,483–$78,591 based on territory size and available discounts. A separate Initial Package Fee of $5,500 is also required. Discounts available: 15% VetFran discount off the minimum $65,000 fee for honorably discharged US/Canadian veterans; 10% Additional Concept Discount for existing affiliates franchisees of at least 2 years. Reduced or deferred fees may be available in special circumstances (economic development, minority programs, new/developing markets).
raw_excerpt: An Initial Franchise Fee of $ 67,000, which is a fee for a territory that includes approximately 40,000 to 60,000 households that meet our current target household demographic criteria (See also Item 12). We reserve the right to charge a greater or smaller Initial Franchise Fee when a larger or smaller territory is granted. If you purchase a territory with more than 60,000 target households, you will pay an additional fee of $0.70 per target household above 60,000. In the year ended December 31, 202 5, the average initial franchise fee paid by Mr. Handyman franchisees was approximately $ 62,355 and the initial franchise fee paid during such period ranged from $28,483 to $78,591 based on the qualified target households in the territory purchased and available discounts (discussed below).
